program_name: Tria Ambassador Program (plus in-app App Referrals)
legal_entity: Threely Dimensions Inc. (Tria) — technology provider named in the Card Terms; the programme operator is not named separately
application_conditions: Help centre (2026-06-14): registration at ambassador.tria.so (not read this run); each ambassador gets a unique referral code on a dashboard; the ambassador account must be linked to a Tria account and 'once linked, this cannot be changed'. No acceptance criteria, channel rules or publisher requirements stated. Separate 'App Referrals' open to all users via a share link in the app's Rewards section.
paid_action: Commissions on three referral activities: card purchase, card spend and futures spend, for users who signed up with the ambassador's code.
validation_conditions: Referred users must use the ambassador's code for tracking; card transactions carry a 90-day settlement period for chargebacks. KYC requirements for payout not stated.

commission.model_note: Direct-sale commission by tier (based on number of cards sold): Bronze 20%, Silver 25%, Gold 30%, Platinum 30–40%, Diamond 50%; indirect (second-level) commission 10% at every tier — Platinum and Diamond on their whole downline, lower tiers on direct referrals only. The base the percentages apply to (card price, spend fees?) is not defined on the page.
commission.tiers_note: Bronze / Silver / Gold / Platinum / Diamond by cards sold; thresholds not stated.

payout.method: 'USD equivalent' paid to the connected Tria wallet
payout.frequency: Card sales and card spend: quarterly; futures spend: monthly
payout.holdbacks_note: 90-day settlement period on card transactions for potential chargebacks.

rules_note: Multi-level structure (10% indirect commission on referred ambassadors' sales) — to be weighed against the site's editorial independence before any application. Formal programme terms not found on the pages read; ambassador.tria.so not fetched.
allowed_countries_note: Not stated. Cardholders must pass KYC in a supported country (help centre: 'over 200 supported regions').

evidence.title: Tria Referrals & Ambassador Program (help centre, June 14, 2026)
evidence.excerpt: 'a more structured referral platform for those looking to earn higher commissions'; registration at ambassador.tria.so; unique referral code; commissions on card purchase, card spend and futures spend; direct 20/25/30/30–40/50% by tier, indirect 10%; paid in USD equivalent to the Tria wallet; card commissions quarterly after a 90-day settlement period, futures monthly.

notes: Identified only. Nobody contacted, no registration made. Commission base undefined on the official page — read the ambassador portal terms before any application. Rewards for referred users not described.
